import os
import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Define paths
input_dir = "./input"
submission_dir = "./submission"

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs(submission_dir, exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(f"{input_dir}/sample_submission.csv")

# Prepare features
feature_cols = train_df.columns.drop(["Id", "Cover_Type"])
X_train_full = train_df[feature_cols]
y_train_full = train_df["Cover_Type"]
X_test = test_df[feature_cols]
test_ids = test_df["Id"]

# Subsample training data to ensure completion within 39 minutes
sample_size = 500000
indices = np.random.choice(train_df.index, sample_size, replace=False)
sub_train = train_df.loc[indices]

# Split into training and validation sets
X_sub_train, X_sub_val, y_sub_train, y_sub_val = train_test_split(
    sub_train[feature_cols], sub_train["Cover_Type"], test_size=0.2, random_state=42
)

# Initialize and train LightGBM model
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=100,
    max_depth=5,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    verbose=-1,
    class_weight="balanced",
    n_jobs=-1,
    random_state=42,
)

model.fit(X_sub_train, y_sub_train)

# Evaluate on validation set
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_sub_val)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_sub_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Accuracy: {val_accuracy}")

# Predict on test set
test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Prepare submission
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids.values, "Cover_Type": test_pred})

# Save submission
submission_df.to_csv(f"{submission_dir}/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
